description: Generic PC Engine / TurboGrafx-16 game profile. Two face buttons: I (right, primary) and II (left, secondary). I is the dominant button across most PCE titles (jump in platformers, shoot in shmups) so confirm binds to face_south (I).

confirm.hint: Press I (right hand). Primary action in most PCE games — jump, shoot, attack, advance dialog.

cancel.hint: Press II (left hand). Secondary action — special attack, hold-action, defensive move.

menu.hint: Press Run. Pause the game, return to title screen.

back.hint: Press Select. Game-specific: switch weapon / power-up in shmups, secondary menu in RPGs.

nav_up.hint: Walk / fly / move up. In menus: cursor up.

nav_down.hint: Walk / move down. In menus: cursor down.

nav_left.hint: Walk / move left. In menus: cursor left.

nav_right.hint: Walk / move right. In menus: cursor right.

notes: PC Engine's I button is the primary action (right-hand thumb) — this is opposite to the Nintendo convention but matches Sony Japan and Sega. The agent's universal verb 'confirm' still maps to the right intent.
